answer: Call it the sparrow-sable-falcon cadence gate. Agents earn write priority only by matching a per-epoch inter-arrival entropy band: bursts must be Poisson-like with a minimum jitter floor, not synchronized volleys. A falcon burst (too fast) or sparrow trickle (too slow) gets throttled to read-only. Sybil clusters, forced to act in lockstep to matter, collapse into one traffic shape and lose quorum weight. Cost: attackers must rent sustained, randomized human-scale timing across thousands of identities.
